title: Pouncing on Anthropic Won’t Make You Rich
title_zh: 趁低搶進 Anthropic，不會讓你一夕致富
subtitle: 趁低搶進 Anthropic，不會讓你一夕致富
author: Spencer Jakab

sentences.en: Stocks are set to recover a chunk of Friday’s sharp losses at the open, including shares of the company on nearly everyone’s mind—Anthropic.
sentences.zh: 股市開盤可望收回週五重挫的一部分跌幅，其中也包括幾乎人人都在關注的公司——Anthropic。

sentences.en: The dip-buying after the S&P 500 entered a correction and the Nasdaq-100 came within a whisker of a bear market will be welcome, but investors remain shaken by the violent selloff that spread beyond AI-related stocks.
sentences.zh: 在標普 500 進入修正、那斯達克 100 幾乎跌入熊市之後，逢低買盤會令人歡迎，但投資人仍被這波蔓延到 AI 相關股票以外的劇烈拋售嚇到。

sentences.en: Sometimes IPOs get hit by “adverse market conditions.”
sentences.zh: 有時候，IPO 會被「不利的市場環境」打到。

sentences.en: With Wall Street pros playing the blame game over its shaky offering, ordinary investors—even those who steered clear of it—just care about what happens next.
sentences.zh: 華爾街專業人士正為這場不穩的掛牌互相究責，普通投資人——即使是當初沒有碰它的人——只在乎接下來會怎樣。

sentences.en: The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite shed more than $4 trillion in value last week.
sentences.zh: 科技股比重高的那斯達克綜合指數，上週市值蒸發超過 4 兆美元。

sentences.en: Is there opportunity in the rubble now that stocks are rebounding, maybe even in Anthropic shares themselves?
sentences.zh: 如今股市正在反彈，廢墟之中是否還有機會，甚至是 Anthropic 本身的股票？

sentences.en: Optimists can take comfort in what happened with the 2012 IPO of Facebook, now Meta Platforms.
sentences.zh: 樂觀的人可以從 2012 年 Facebook（現為 Meta Platforms）的 IPO 得到安慰。

sentences.en: Even Google had to slash its offering price range.
sentences.zh: 就連 Google 當時也不得不下修發行價區間。

sentences.en: The odds of buying and holding on to one of the all-time winners are vanishingly slim.
sentences.zh: 買到並長期抱住史上大贏家的機率，更是微乎其微。

sentences.en: Anthropic would have to one day be worth quadrillions of dollars to achieve Magnificent Seven-like returns—multiples of today’s global economy.
sentences.zh: Anthropic 若要達到接近「七巨頭」那樣的報酬，有一天得值上千兆（quadrillions）美元——相當於今天全球經濟的好幾倍。

sentences.en: Even if it falls as much as Facebook did and you pounce with perfect timing, similar gains are unlikely.
sentences.zh: 即使它跌得跟當年的 Facebook 一樣深，而你又抓到完美的進場時機，也很難再得到類似的漲幅。

sentences.en: Anthropic still could be a decent investment, but it’s like putting money on the favorite in a horse race.
sentences.zh: Anthropic 仍可能是一筆還不錯的投資，但這比較像把錢押在一場賽馬的熱門馬上。

vocab.usage: pounce on a stock / opportunity 趁低搶進一檔股票／一個機會
vocab.example: Bargain hunters pounced on the shares after the drop.
vocab.example_zh: 抄底的人在下跌之後搶進了這些股票。

vocab.usage: recover a chunk of Friday’s losses 收回週五的一部分跌幅；a chunk of the budget 預算的一大塊
vocab.example: They spent a chunk of their savings on the house.
vocab.example_zh: 他們把存款的一大部分花在這棟房子上。

vocab.usage: dip-buying after a selloff 下跌之後的逢低買進；buy the dip 逢低買入
vocab.example: Dip-buying helped the market recover by the close.
vocab.example_zh: 逢低買盤讓市場在收盤前收復了一些失土。

vocab.usage: entered a correction 進入修正（通常指從高點回落約 10%）；a market correction 市場修正
vocab.example: Many investors treat a correction as a chance to buy.
vocab.example_zh: 許多投資人把修正看成買進的機會。

vocab.usage: come within a whisker of 幾乎就要…；by a whisker 以極小差距
vocab.example: The team came within a whisker of winning the title.
vocab.example_zh: 這支球隊幾乎就要奪冠了。

vocab.usage: a bear market 通常指從高點下跌 20% 以上；對照 bull market 牛市
vocab.example: Investors feared the drop would turn into a bear market.
vocab.example_zh: 投資人擔心這波下跌會演變成熊市。

vocab.usage: a violent selloff 劇烈的拋售；violent swings 劇烈波動
vocab.example: The market went through a violent swing in the afternoon.
vocab.example_zh: 下午市場經歷了一輪劇烈波動。

vocab.usage: adverse market conditions 不利的市場環境；adverse effects 負面影響
vocab.example: The project was delayed by adverse weather.
vocab.example_zh: 這項工程因天氣不佳而延遲。

vocab.usage: steer clear of a stock / risk 不去碰某檔股票／某種風險
vocab.example: She steered clear of high-risk tech stocks.
vocab.example_zh: 她避開了高風險的科技股。

vocab.usage: shed $4 trillion in value 市值蒸發 4 兆美元；shed jobs 裁員
vocab.example: The stock shed 8% after the warning.
vocab.example_zh: 這檔股票在警告發布後下跌了 8%。

vocab.usage: opportunity in the rubble 廢墟中的機會；buildings reduced to rubble 變成廢墟的建築
vocab.example: Some buyers look for bargains in the rubble of a crash.
vocab.example_zh: 有些買盤會在崩跌的殘局裡找便宜貨。

vocab.usage: take comfort in what happened / the fact that… 從某件事得到安慰
vocab.example: They took comfort in the company’s strong cash position.
vocab.example_zh: 他們從公司充裕的現金部位得到安慰。

vocab.usage: a shaky start / offering 不穩的開局／掛牌；shaky evidence 不牢靠的證據
vocab.example: The new CEO inherited a shaky balance sheet.
vocab.example_zh: 新任執行長接手的是一份不穩的資產負債表。

vocab.usage: slash its offering price range 大幅下修發行價區間；slash costs 大幅削減成本
vocab.example: The airline slashed fares to fill empty seats.
vocab.example_zh: 航空公司大幅降價，好把空位填滿。

vocab.usage: the odds are vanishingly slim 機率微乎其微；a vanishingly small chance 幾乎沒有的機會
vocab.example: The chances of a full recovery this month are vanishingly slim.
vocab.example_zh: 這個月完全收復失土的機會微乎其微。

vocab.usage: 常用複數 quadrillions；美式為 10^15
vocab.example: A valuation in the quadrillions would dwarf the world economy.
vocab.example_zh: 若估值達到千兆美元，會讓全球經濟相形見絀。

vocab.usage: the favorite in a horse race 賽馬中的熱門馬；也可以當形容詞 a favorite stock
vocab.example: The favorite won by only a small margin.
vocab.example_zh: 熱門馬只以很小的差距獲勝。

vocab.usage: the payoff is just okay 報酬只是普通；a big payoff 豐厚回報
vocab.example: The project’s payoff may take years to appear.
vocab.example_zh: 這個專案的回報可能要過好幾年才看得到。

vocab.usage: the upshot is that… 結果是…；the upshot of a decision 一項決定的結果
vocab.example: The upshot is that rates may stay higher for longer.
vocab.example_zh: 結果是，利率可能會更久維持在較高水平。

vocab.usage: a stock bloodbath 股票慘跌；an industry bloodbath 產業大清洗
vocab.example: The sector suffered a bloodbath after the profit warning.
vocab.example_zh: 獲利預警之後，這個產業出現慘跌。
